subject: Enable integration tests + ASan (#162)
reason: The change modifies only CI and test infrastructure: a new GitHub Actions workflow that runs integration tests under ASan, build.sh plumbing to forward an --asan flag, an LSan suppression file (ci/asan.supp), and a refactor of testing/integration/run.sh (ASan build dir suffix, env-var printing, log scanning for ASan errors, cleanup trap). No module source code is changed, so the valkey-search module binary built at the change behaves identically to the parent's; there is no runtime behaviour a fuzzer scenario could reach or compare.
